eq-ch14-launch-rank: Global block rank from process rank and local block index, and back.
eq-ch14-msgmatch-tag: Exchange message tag from the sync id, local block, buffer and variable index; it is one to one.
eq-ch14-restart-next: On resume, an output's next time is clamped to one interval ahead; a new output joins the grid at or below the restored time.
eq-ch14-schedule-moments: Time-weighted running mean and deviation of output statistics (weighted Welford recurrence).
